subject: Next steps: vendor onboarding & PO cadence for Lakeside Health
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@lakesidehealth.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & next steps: vendor onboarding / procurement info

Hi Olivia — thanks for carving out time earlier. Quick recap from our discovery today and a few suggested next steps so procurement can run the intake efficiently:

- Key ask from your side: confirm procurement contact, required intake artifacts (W9, compliance questionnaire), and preferred invoice/PO cadence.
- Redwood commitments: provide SOC 2 summary, vendor intake checklist, and a short SOW draft for pilot scope.
- Timeline we discussed: target pilot start in early Q3; procurement + security review to land first PO by early July if possible.

Action items for Lakeside (please confirm):
1) Procurement contact + email for official vendor intake (we heard Jenna Park might be the owner).
2) Any specific invoice terms (net30, net45, single PO vs multiple POs).
3) Preferred protocol for security evidence intake (uploaded to portal vs emailed).

I've attached a lightweight Redwood-Vendor-Setup-Checklist.pdf and a prelim-sow.docx to speed the intake. Happy to hop on a 15-min alignment call with Jenna if that helps.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
attachments: Redwood-Vendor-Setup-Checklist.pdf; prelim-sow.docx

From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@lakesidehealth.org>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Procurement Ops <procurement@lakesidehealth.org>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 11:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps: vendor onboarding / procurement info

Thanks Sergio — great recap. Confirming:
- Procurement owner: Jenna Park (jenna.park@lakesidehealth.org, +1-415-555-0182). Looping her in for next steps.
- Typical intake artifacts: completed Vendor Intake Form (attached), W9, insurance certificate, and a brief SOC2 attestation (summary doc is fine for intake).
- Invoice/PO: Lakeside prefers a single PO per quarter for platform services; standard terms are net30. If Redwood requires monthly invoices instead of a single quarterly PO, we can discuss routing to finance.

Procurement will review your checklist and intake form. Two small clarifications: do you need a portal upload or can we email docs to procurement@lakesidehealth.org? Also, any minimum SLA or termination language we should flag to legal upfront?

Appreciate you including the SOW — we'll review and come back with any scope questions.

Best,
Olivia
Director, Digital Programs
Lakeside Health
attachments: VendorIntakeForm.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jenna Park <jenna.park@lakesidehealth.org>, Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@lakesidehealth.org>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps: vendor onboarding / procurement info

Thanks Jenna / Olivia — looping in a couple quick clarifications from Redwood's ops and legal side so procurement has what it needs to avoid back-and-forth later:

- Invoicing: we can support both a single quarterly PO invoiced monthly and a single-quarter lump-sum invoice. If Lakeside prefers one PO for the quarter invoiced monthly, confirm the PO number once issued and we'll route invoices to the finance mailbox you provide.
- W9 & compliance: we'll attach a SOC2 summary and vendor W9. If you prefer portal upload, point us to the link; otherwise we can send via secure email to procurement@lakesidehealth.org.
- SLAs / termination: attached is a short SLA-Exception-request.docx that flags optional uptime/service credits and pilot termination windows for discussion. If Legal has redlines, please route them to contracts@redwood.ai — we typically turn around standard redlines within 5 business days.

Deliverables from Redwood by EOD Tuesday (26 May): SOC2-redwood-summary.pdf, completed vendor intake (in our copy), and a short pilot SOW with pricing.

If helpful, I'm available for a 15-min call Wed morning to align on PO mechanics and evidence transfer.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success (Pre-Sales)
Redwood Inference
attachments: SLA-Exception-request.docx; SOC2-redwood-summary.pdf

From: Jenna Park <jenna.park@lakesidehealth.org>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@lakesidehealth.org>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps: vendor onboarding / procurement info

Appreciate the clear summary — procurement has reviewed the checklist and the attached SOC2 summary. A few notes and the intake timeline so you can plan deliverables: 

- Preferred artifact intake: please upload the Vendor Intake Form, W9, and SOC2 summary to our secure vendor portal (https://vendors.lakesidehealth.org/register). If you have a portal issue, email procurement@lakesidehealth.org with subject line: Redwood Intake.
- Intake deadlines: vendor intake form + docs due by 2027-06-02. Security team will complete their review by 2027-06-16. We expect contracting to complete by 2027-06-30 and PO issuance by 2027-07-05 (net30 terms).
- Invoicing: Lakeside will issue a single PO for the Q3 pilot; please invoice monthly against that PO. Finance contact: finance@lakesidehealth.org.
- DocuSign: contracting will use the standard DocuSign route; I'll open the envelope once security clears. (DocuSign link will be provided from our side when ready.)

If Redwood can confirm SOC2 summary + Vendor Intake upload by 6/2, procurement will treat Redwood as an active vendor candidate and move to contracting. Thanks — happy to do a quick portal walk-through if you prefer.

Regards,
Jenna Park
Vendor Onboarding Lead
Lakeside Health
attachments: none
